# Motherlover — Divine Maternal Service | Lara Süß (Birth & Postpartum Doula Berlin)

> Certified English & German speaking Birth and Postpartum Doula based in Berlin-Kreuzberg (Obentrautstraße 32, 10963 Berlin). Supporting expectant mothers and families across all of Berlin since 2020 (approx. 30 births and 60+ postpartum families supported).

## Core Services & Pricing
- **Pregnancy Support (`https://motherloverberlin.de/schwangerschaft/` | EN: `/en/schwangerschaft/`)**: Individual & couples prenatal sessions, birth mapping, VBAC/home/hospital preparation, prenatal Ayurvedic massage (€200 per ~2h session).
- **Mama Blessing Ceremony**: Traditional blessing circle with cacao ritual, mantra singing, meditation, and nesting (€300 – €490).
- **Birth Doula Support (`https://motherloverberlin.de/geburt/` | EN: `/en/geburt/`)**: Continuous 1:1 birth accompaniment in Berlin (home birth, birth center, hospital, cesarean, VBAC), 24/7 on-call window (37+0 to 42+3), Rebozo comfort measures, backup doula included (€2,100; sliding scale/exchange available for BIPOC, single mothers, low-income families).
- **Postpartum / Wochenbett Care (`https://motherloverberlin.de/postpartum/` | EN: `/en/postpartum/`)**: Nourishing postpartum cooking, newborn care, sleep support, warm oil massages (€60/h single baby, €65/h twins; 10-session packages €1,100 / €2,100).
- **Herbal Bath & Postpartum Massage Ritual**: 3-hour restorative infusion & warm oil bodywork (€210).
- **Postpartum Massage at Home**: 2-hour home visit massage (€150 – €180).
- **Closing the Bones Ritual**: Traditional Mexican Rebozo closing ceremony from 6 weeks postpartum (€300 – €450).
- **Birth Pool Rental Berlin (`https://motherloverberlin.de/gebaerpool/` | EN: `/en/gebaerpool/`)**: Complete home water birth pool kit incl. brand-new single-use liner (€160 per rental).
- **Gift Vouchers (`https://motherloverberlin.de/gutscheine/` | EN: `/en/gutscheine/`)**: Vouchers for Prenatal Massage, Postpartum Massage, Mama Blessing, and Closing the Bones Ritual.
